note: The Northern Mariana Islands: residence as a non-citizen is the United States' (its visas, green cards and their terms), since the Immigration and Nationality Act counts the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands within the United States in a geographical sense. Read in the United States Code, 2023 edition, on govinfo.gov on 2026-10-30.

sources.title: United States Code, 2023 edition (govinfo.gov), 8 U.S.C. § 1101, Definitions
sources.said: (38) The term "United States", except as otherwise specifically herein provided, when used in a geographical sense, means the continental United States, Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico, Guam, the Virgin Islands of the United States, and the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands.
